theorem PalomarDecompression.markedAdviceCodec (m q slots : Nat) (hq : LT.lt 0 q)
  (capacity : LE.le (HPow.hPow 2 (HAdd.hAdd 1 m)) (HPow.hPow q slots)) :
  Exists fun encode =>
    Exists fun readAdvice =>
      Exists fun readPayload =>
        ∀ (a : Fin 2) (p : Fin m → Fin 2),
          And (Eq (readAdvice (encode a p)) a)
            (And (Eq (readPayload (encode a p)) p)
              (∀ (i : Option (Fin slots)), Iff (Eq (encode a p i) 0) (Eq i Option.none)))
name: PalomarDecompression.markedAdviceCodec

theorem PalomarDecompression.largeComponentPartition.{u_1} {V : Type u_1} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
  [DecidableRel (SimpleGraph.Adj G)] (hconn : SimpleGraph.Connected G) (id : V → Nat) (hinj : Function.Injective id)
  (r Δ : Nat) (hdegree : ∀ (v : V), LE.le (SimpleGraph.degree G v) Δ) (hlarge : LT.lt r (Fintype.card V)) :
  Exists fun roots =>
    And (Finset.Nonempty roots)
      (And
        (∀ (a : V),
          Membership.mem roots a →
            ∀ (b : V), Membership.mem roots b → Ne a b → LT.lt (HMul.hMul 2 r) (SimpleGraph.dist G a b))
        (And (∀ (v : V), Exists fun c => And (Membership.mem roots c) (LE.le (SimpleGraph.dist G c v) (HMul.hMul 2 r)))
          (And (∀ (v : V), ExistsUnique fun c => PalomarDecompression.NearestRoot G roots id c v)
            (And
              (∀ (c : V),
                Membership.mem roots c →
                  And (LE.le (HAdd.hAdd r 1) (Finset.card (PalomarDecompression.rootCell G roots id c)))
                    (LE.le (Finset.card (PalomarDecompression.rootCell G roots id c))
                      (HPow.hPow (HAdd.hAdd Δ 1) (HMul.hMul 2 r))))
              (And
                (∀ (c v : V),
                  PalomarDecompression.NearestRoot G roots id c v → LE.le (SimpleGraph.dist G c v) (HMul.hMul 2 r))
                (∀ (c v : V),
                  PalomarDecompression.NearestRoot G roots id c v →
                    Exists fun p =>
                      And (SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath p)
                        (And (Eq (SimpleGraph.Walk.length p) (SimpleGraph.dist G c v))
                          (∀ (w : V),
                            Membership.mem (SimpleGraph.Walk.support p) w →
                              PalomarDecompression.NearestRoot G roots id c w))))))))
name: PalomarDecompression.largeComponentPartition

theorem PalomarDecompression.arbitraryLabelCellGeometry.{u_1} {V : Type u_1} [Fintype V] [LinearOrder V] {q : Nat}
  (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel (SimpleGraph.Adj G)] (hconn : SimpleGraph.Connected G) (id : V → Nat)
  (hinj : Function.Injective id) (R Δ : Nat) (hdegree : ∀ (v : V), LE.le (SimpleGraph.degree G v) Δ)
  (labels : V → Fin (HAdd.hAdd q 1)) (c : V) :
  And (Iff (Finset.Nonempty (PalomarDecompression.truncatedCell G id R labels c)) (Eq (labels c) 0))
    (And (LE.le (Finset.card (PalomarDecompression.truncatedCell G id R labels c)) (HPow.hPow (HAdd.hAdd Δ 1) R))
      (And
        (∀ (v : V),
          Membership.mem (PalomarDecompression.truncatedCell G id R labels c) v →
            Exists fun p =>
              And (SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath p)
                (And (Eq (SimpleGraph.Walk.length p) (SimpleGraph.dist G c v))
                  (And (LE.le (SimpleGraph.Walk.length p) R)
                    (∀ (w : V),
                      Membership.mem (SimpleGraph.Walk.support p) w →
                        Membership.mem (PalomarDecompression.truncatedCell G id R labels c) w))))
        (∀ (v : V), Membership.mem (PalomarDecompression.truncatedCell G id R labels c) v → Ne v c → Ne (labels v) 0)))
name: PalomarDecompression.arbitraryLabelCellGeometry

theorem PalomarDecompression.graphMarkerReconstruction.{u_1} {V : Type u_1} [Fintype V] [LinearOrder V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
  [DecidableRel (SimpleGraph.Adj G)] (hconn : SimpleGraph.Connected G) (id : V → Nat) (hinj : Function.Injective id)
  (k : Nat) (hk : LE.le 2 k) (hlarge : LT.lt (HMul.hMul 16 (HAdd.hAdd k 1)) (Fintype.card V))
  (hdegree : ∀ (v : V), LE.le (SimpleGraph.degree G v) (HSub.hSub (HMul.hMul 2 k) 1))
  (orientation :
    (roots : Finset V) →
      Finset.Nonempty roots →
        ((Subtype fun x => Membership.mem roots x) → Fin 2) → PalomarDecompression.GraphEdge G → Fin 2) :
  Exists fun decode =>
    ∀ (roots : Finset V) (hne : Finset.Nonempty roots),
      (∀ (a : V),
          Membership.mem roots a →
            ∀ (b : V),
              Membership.mem roots b →
                Ne a b → LT.lt (HMul.hMul 2 (HMul.hMul 16 (HAdd.hAdd k 1))) (SimpleGraph.dist G a b)) →
        ∀ (part : V → Subtype fun x => Membership.mem roots x),
          (∀ (v : V), PalomarDecompression.NearestRoot G roots id (Subtype.val (part v)) v) →
            And
              (∀ (advice : (Subtype fun x => Membership.mem roots x) → Fin 2),
                PalomarDecompression.BalancedBoundaryAdvice (fun e => Prod.fst (Subtype.val e))
                    (fun e => Prod.snd (Subtype.val e)) part (orientation roots hne) advice →
                  Exists fun encode =>
                    ∀ (input : PalomarDecompression.GraphEdge G → Fin 2),
                      And (Eq (decode (encode input)) input)
                        (And (Eq (PalomarDecompression.zeroMarkers (encode input)) roots)
                          (∀ (R : Nat),
                            (∀ (v : V),
                                Exists fun c => And (Membership.mem roots c) (LE.le (SimpleGraph.dist G c v) R)) →
                              ∀ (c : Subtype fun x => Membership.mem roots x),
                                Eq
                                  (PalomarDecompression.packetAdvice (HSub.hSub (HPow.hPow 2 k) 1) G id R (encode input)
                                    (Subtype.val c))
                                  ↑(advice c))))
              (∀ (r T : Nat),
                (∀ (v : V),
                    Exists fun c => And (Membership.mem roots c) (LE.le (SimpleGraph.dist G c v) (HMul.hMul 2 r))) →
                  PalomarDecompression.CellOrientationLocal G part (orientation roots hne) T →
                    ∀ (x y : V → Fin (HAdd.hAdd (HSub.hSub (HPow.hPow 2 k) 1) 1)),
                      Eq (PalomarDecompression.zeroMarkers x) roots →
                        Eq (PalomarDecompression.zeroMarkers y) roots →
                          ∀ (e : PalomarDecompression.GraphEdge G),
                            (∀ (v : V),
                                LE.le (SimpleGraph.dist G (Prod.fst (Subtype.val e)) v)
                                    (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 4 r) 1) T) (HMul.hMul 8 r))
                                      2) →
                                  Eq (x v) (y v)) →
                              Eq (decode x e) (decode y e))
name: PalomarDecompression.graphMarkerReconstruction
